title: Find the Longest Common Prefix
real_world_story: A document-management system organizes related documents by common naming or textual prefixes. Given several document names, the system needs to identify the longest prefix shared by all of them.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Names or strings associated with documents
real_world_connection.target_represents: Common beginning shared by all document names
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Comparing characters across strings to determine their longest common prefix

problem_statement: Given N strings, find the longest common prefix shared by every string. If the strings have no common prefix, print -1.
task: Determine the longest sequence of starting characters that is identical in all given document names.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated lowercase strings.
output_format: Print the longest common prefix. If there is no common prefix, print -1.
constraints: Strings contain only lowercase English letters

examples.explanation: All four strings begin with 'app', and the next character is not common to all strings.
The three strings do not share a common starting character.

expected_algorithm.name: Longest Common Prefix
expected_algorithm.reason: The common prefix can be found by comparing characters position by position across all strings or by progressively reducing a candidate prefix.

hint: Start with the first string as the candidate prefix.
Compare it with the other strings.
Shorten the candidate whenever characters differ.
If the candidate becomes empty, there is no common prefix.
real_world_takeaway: Longest-common-prefix processing is useful for grouping related document names, organizing hierarchical text labels, and identifying shared naming patterns.
